content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable and similar platforms provide a comprehensive infrastructure for course creation and sales, but they come with stringent country restrictions and high fees. Stripe and PayPal offer robust payment processing but limit access based on geographical location. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, allows creators to build their own sales systems using free tools, ensuring they have full control over their operations without the risk of account suspension or geographical limitations.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal often exclude entire countries from their services, effectively locking out millions of potential sellers. Teachable and Gumroad follow suit, restricting access based on the user's location. In contrast, sovereign commerce solutions like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack are designed with inclusivity in mind. By leveraging free infrastructure tools and cryptocurrency payments, creators can bypass traditional restrictions and establish a fully functional sales operation regardless of their location.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing through Stripe and PayPal can involve delays, especially if an account is flagged or suspended. PayPal has been known to hold funds for up to 180 days without appeal, which can cripple a creator's cash flow. In contrast, using the Edge Commerce Stack with NOWPayments ensures that creators receive payments almost instantly in over 300 cryptocurrencies, with only a 0.5% fee, providing a reliable and cost-effective solution for digital commerce.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure allows you to build a resilient online store.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When using platforms like Gumroad or Teachable, creators often do not own their customer data or product delivery systems, putting them at risk of losing everything if the platform changes its policies. Conversely, the Edge Commerce Stack offers full ownership of all components of the sales process. Creators can automate product delivery and payment verification without relying on third-party platforms, ensuring that they maintain complete control over their digital products and customer interactions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in restricted countries, the choice is clear: traditional platforms limit sales while sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers them. If you need a quick and efficient solution, the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal. It allows you to deploy a complete commerce system in 48 hours, configure your payment processing, and start selling digital products immediately without the fear of account restrictions or suspensions.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Full ownership means no more account suspensions or geographical restrictions.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
